title: Transcription factor NF-kappaB as target for SARS-CoV-2 drug discovery efforts using inflammation-based QSAR screening model.
authors: Kanan, Tarek; Kanan, Duaa; Al Shardoub, Ebrahim Jaafar; Durdagi, Serdar
one_liner_zh: 该研究以NF-kappaB转录因子为靶点，结合QSAR筛选和分子动力学模拟寻找抗炎抑制剂，虽涉及TF蛋白-配体互作，但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: NF-kappaB is a central regulator of immunity and inflammation. It is suggested that the inflammatory response mediated by SARS-CoV-2 is predominated by NF-kappaB activation. Thus, NF-kappaB inhibition is considered a potential therapeutic strategy for COVID-19. The aim of this study was to identify potential anti-inflammation lead molecules that target NF-kappaB using a quantitative structure-activity relationships (QSAR) model of currently used and investigated anti-inflammatory drugs as the basis for screening. We applied an integrated approach by starting with the inflammation-based QSAR model to screen three libraries containing more than 220,000 drug-like molecules for the purpose of finding potential drugs that target the NF-kappaB/IkappaBalpha p50/p65 (RelA) complex. We also used QSAR models to rule out molecules that were predicted to be toxic. Among screening libraries, 382 molecules were selected as potentially nontoxic and were analyzed further by short and long molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and free energy calculations. We have discovered five hit ligands with highly predicted anti-inflammation activity and nearly no predicted toxicities which had strongly favorable protein-ligand interactions and conformational stability at the binding pocket compared to a known NF-kappaB inhibitor (procyanidin B2). We propose these hit molecules as potential NF-kappaB inhibitors which can be further investigated in pre-clinical studies against SARS-CoV-2 and may be used as a scaffold for chemical optimization and drug development efforts.
abstract_zh: NF-kappaB是免疫和炎症的中心调节因子。研究表明，SARS-CoV-2介导的炎症反应主要由NF-kappaB激活主导。因此，抑制NF-kappaB被认为是COVID-19的潜在治疗策略。本研究旨在利用当前使用和研究的抗炎药物的定量构效关系（QSAR）模型作为筛选基础，识别靶向NF-kappaB的潜在抗炎先导分子。我们采用了一种综合方法，首先基于炎症QSAR模型筛选三个包含超过220,000个药物样分子的库，以寻找靶向NF-kappaB/IkappaBalpha p50/p65 (RelA)复合物的潜在药物。我们还使用QSAR模型排除预测有毒性的分子。在筛选库中，382个分子被选为潜在无毒，并通过短程和长程分子动力学（MD）模拟及自由能计算进一步分析。我们发现了五个具有高预测抗炎活性和几乎无预测毒性的命中配体，与已知NF-kappaB抑制剂（原花青素B2）相比，它们在结合口袋处表现出强有利的蛋白质-配体相互作用和构象稳定性。我们提出这些命中分子作为潜在的NF-kappaB抑制剂，可在针对SARS-CoV-2的临床前研究中进一步探索，并可能用作化学优化和药物开发工作的支架。
